name: Honjou Aiko
source:
She comes from a middle class family and attends a regular co-ed school. She is an active, boyish girl. She has never had a boyfriend, but is interested in love. She has a straightforward personality and has many friends, both boys and girls.

She has been best friends with Mayumi since childhood, and the two of them still hang out together often. She admires Mayumi's girly personality and is a little jealous of her, however, she is careful to remind herself that such feelings are a betrayal of her friend.

She is a good-natured and considerate person, and when people ask her for a favor, she has a hard time saying no. Especially when men insist. She is especially susceptible to requests from men.

She likes good-looking men.
